title: Pool Filter Cleaning Brush – Nozzle with Pressure Control
descriptionHtml:
A clean pool filter in minutes – not hours

A clogged filter makes the water cloudy and forces the pool pump to work harder than it needs to. Rinsing the filter by hand is wet, tedious and rarely gets it truly clean.

Flush it clean in a single pass

The brush connects straight to the garden hose and flushes between the filter's pleats with targeted water pressure. The adjustable switch lets you control the flow so you remove dirt, leaves and grease without tearing up the paper core.

Features

  • Adjustable water pressure with a switch
  • Cleans the filter pleats quickly and gently
  • Connects directly to a regular garden hose
  • Fits pool and spa filters with a paper core
  • Extends the filter's life and keeps the water clear

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
